## Notable fixes

- Builds now carry on past LaTeX errors and show every error, keeping a PDF on screen: the errored PDF, or the last good one. Turn on Stop on first error per project to get the old behaviour.
- Agent panel updated to Synara 1.0.8: a running-agents capsule above the composer, complete diffs while a turn runs, Codex warnings shown, provider hand-off, and a new-chat button in the tab bar.
- Presentations updated to Open Slide 2.3.1.

## Smaller fixes

- Settings section headings are back, and the project dictionary row lines up with the rest.
